transcript: It's horrible, said the captain. She said it quite cheerfully. It's the worst lane I've ever stood. I'll do it to somebody next year. She unfolded her arms. Hebden's my cousin. Her legs are white, not grey. The healer says she'll stand on Friday. I'm glad. So am I. The captain looked at Kiva's bleeding hand and at Pruse. I'd rather not beat you. I'd rather not lose to you either. It's an awkward thing to feel in the middle of a lane. She turned away. Third carry. Mind your elbows.
